lesson_title: LESSON 07: Sharing the Road & Special Circumstances
prompt: What information should you provide to dispatchers when reporting an aggressive driver on a Texas highway?

options.text: Driver's estimated personal household income and automobile loan balance
The manufacturer serial number of the tires installed on the suspect car
Vehicle make/model/color, license plate, highway location, direction, and behavior
Predictions of which exit the aggressive vehicle will take ten miles ahead
